SubLevelDesc: Give 2 subtrahends without borrow in minutes.
Expression:
$majorunit = 'hours'
$minorunit = 'minutes'
$mulFactor = 60
$opnmjr1 = random(0, 0)
$opnmjr2 = random(0, 0)
$opnmnr1 = random([40, 45, 50, 55])
$opnmnr2 = random([10, 20, 30, 40])
$nums = [toNumber($mulFactor), toNumber($opnmjr1), toNumber($opnmjr2), toNumber($opnmnr1), toNumber($opnmnr2)]
$borrow = iff((($opnmnr1 - $opnmnr2))<0, $mulFactor, 0)
$ansmnr = (($opnmnr1 + $borrow) - $opnmnr2) % $mulFactor
$ansmjr = ($opnmjr1 - $borrow/$mulFactor) - $opnmjr2
Description: Tests the concept of subtraction of measures of time.
Subject: Other
